card.title: Hand Over the Proof
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the actual note, not your description.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can read it to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I want the words that don't get your emphasis.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then show me the one line you're using to decide for me.

mechanism: A seeks direct access to decisive written evidence and narrows the request to overcome privacy objections.
confusable: Unlike merely disputing B's judgment, A must pursue the actual information that would permit an independent decision.
comparison: Access is negotiated through reading emphasis and one private line; the other scene offers shared liability for a key.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
